title: Why is TestRetry flaky?
summary: Wall-clock reads and shared subtest state are the first suspects.

messages.content: You are an assistant for a CLI tool. Answer concisely and informatively. Prefer markdown if possible.
TestRetry fails about once in twenty runs. Where should I look first?
Check for wall-clock reads before you touch the retry logic: sleeps and time.Now comparisons make the test order-dependent. Also look for shared state between parallel subtests.
